lines: Agents getting robbed is the story of 2026. One prompt injection drained a hundred and fifty thousand dollars. HumanPay fixes that.
The anti-drain layer is the product. Proof of personhood, one-time limits, and a peer allowlist work together.
Sign in with email, Google, or your own wallet. Self custody, always.
Every rail reports honestly. Settlement is live on Celo mainnet. Proof of human is clearly labelled.
Real USA Tether moves peer to peer, and the server never holds your keys.
Set your boundaries once. Per transaction, per day, lifetime. Integers, no drift.
A drain attempt gets blocked, and the block itself is recorded.
Every allow and every block lands on a tamper evident hash chain, recomputable by anyone.
Your own pay link and QR. A channel you own.
Split a bill with friends. Remainder safe integer shares.
Recurring subscriptions auto run inside your limits.
Quote a corridor. Nigeria, Brazil, Argentina.
Independence is checked on chain, the sixty day rule made visible.
Tagged settlements carry the assigned code. Live and inspectable.
HumanPay. An agent you can trust with money. Live now.
